meta.company: Panco Foods Inc. (DBA Pan's Mushroom Jerky)
meta.thesis: Pan's won Mark Cuban on Shark Tank - now Texas students pitch Pan's, and every pitch is a reason to taste it at H-E-B.
meta.variant_angle: Pans B: community challenge - Pitch Your Flavor

business_problem: Pan's grew from ~750 to 2,500+ stores while revenue fell and losses continued: shoppers are not trying the product at the shelf, and Gen Z - the most flavor-curious buyers - has no reason to engage with a brand they file under declining plant-based meat.

objectives.text: Drive 5,000 attributed purchases at Central Texas H-E-B stores and online in 45 days
Collect 1,500 flavor pitches and 6,000 new email/SMS subscribers

segments.name: Gen-Z Snack Explorers (14-24)
segments.demographic: 14-24, high school and college students, mixed income, Central Texas
segments.geographic: Austin, Round Rock, Georgetown, San Marcos, Waco (Texas District 5 area)
segments.psychographic: Curious about new flavors, 'better-for-you' leaning but taste-first; skeptical of products that imitate meat
segments.behavioral: Buys savory snacks weekly at H-E-B, c-stores, and campus stores; tries new snacks from creator content and friends
segments.media: TikTok and Instagram Reels daily; YouTube; group chats; low email use

segments.name: Flexitarian H-E-B Parents (30-50)
segments.demographic: 30-50, household income $60K+, parents buying lunchbox and after-school snacks
segments.geographic: Central Texas suburbs served by H-E-B
segments.psychographic: Wants cleaner snacks with no allergens to worry about; open to plant-based but not willing to pay for disappointment
segments.behavioral: Weekly H-E-B shopper; uses the H-E-B app and digital coupons; buys meat snacks for kids
segments.media: Facebook, Instagram, H-E-B app, email newsletters

methods.recruitment: SEC filing, GFI/SPINS, Circana via trade press, company pages

programs.name: Pitch Your Flavor Open Call
programs.mechanic: Texas students (14+, parental consent under 18) film a 30-second Shark Tank-style pitch for the next Pan's flavor, posted with #PitchYourFlavor. No purchase necessary; official rules on the landing page. Each entrant gets a coupon.

programs.name: Taste-Before-You-Pitch Demo Days
programs.mechanic: 16 weekend demo shifts at 8 Central Texas H-E-B stores: shoppers taste the current flavors, get a 'buy 2 save $3' QR coupon, and can enter a pitch on the spot.

programs.name: Campus Tank Finals
programs.mechanic: Top 5 pitches present live at a Central Texas campus event (proposed with business student orgs); founder Michael Pan judges by video; winner's flavor goes into proposed R&D for a Texas limited edition.

programs.name: Creator Pitch Squad
programs.mechanic: 4 Texas food creators post their own flavor pitch in week 1 to model the format, then duet top fan pitches; each has a unique coupon code and #ad disclosure.

lines.item: Paid social (TikTok, Meta) geo-targeted to Texas
Campus Tank Finals: prizes, stage, livestream

kpis.kpi: Attributed purchases (coupon codes + QR + online orders)
kpis.tool: Coupon platform + Shopify + unique creator codes

assumptions.text: Brand revenue per purchase ~$8.00: 2 bags at ~$4.00 wholesale (~50% of $7.99-8.99 shelf price); confirm with company
Gross margin ~42%: average of FY22 (40%), FY23 (30%), and YTD FY24 (57%) from SEC filing figures
H-E-B store-level baseline velocity unknown; measured week 0 via shelf audit + company sell-through data
Paid social: ~$2.30 CPM; 1.5% CTR on coupon creative; 12% coupon-claim-to-purchase (validate week 1)
Pan's and H-E-B would approve in-store demos and a digital coupon (proposed, not confirmed)
Texas food micro-creators (10K-80K followers): ~$750 per video incl. product
In-store demo shift ~$150 (4-hr demo staff via sampling agency, product included)
Coupon cost: $1.50 brand-funded discount on first 1,000 redemptions; beyond that absorbed in margin
Production (shelf talkers, sample cups, design) ~$800 via local print shop quotes
Email/SMS + landing page tools ~$300 for the campaign window
Event costs: campus venue comped by student orgs; prizes and stage materials ~$1,500

slides.title: Campaign Overview
bullets: Thesis: Pan's won its Shark Tank pitch - now Texas students pitch Pan's [S4].
Problem: Pan's grew from ~750 to 2,500+ stores, yet revenue fell from $3.15M (FY22) with losses every year - shoppers are not trying it [S1][S2][S4].
Business opportunity: meat snacks +11.3% to $6.4B while plant-based meat fell 10% - flavor-curious Gen Z needs a reason to see Pan's as a snack, not fake meat [S6][S7].
Solution: 'Pan's Tank' invites Texas students to pitch the next flavor Shark Tank-style - and taste Pan's at H-E-B to do it [O1].
45-day goal: 5,000 attributed purchases and 1,500 flavor pitches [O1][O2].

visual.desc: Four boxes: Problem / Business opportunity / Solution / 45-day goal

slides.notes: Open with the paradox: Pan's went from about 750 stores to 2,500, yet revenue fell. The problem is not distribution - it is what happens at the shelf.

slides.title: The Product
bullets: Shiitake mushroom jerky from a decades-old Pan family recipe found in Malaysia; chewy, savory, umami [S2].
Vegan, gluten-free, Kosher, no allergens to declare; the brand says it 'isn't trying to completely imitate beef' [S5].
Shelf price $7.99-$8.99 per 2.2 oz bag; cost to make about $1.67 per bag at launch [S3].
Four core flavors; sold online, on Amazon, and in grocery including H-E-B in Texas [S2][S10].

visual.desc: Flat-lay of four flavor bags with a torn-open bag showing the jerky texture

slides.notes: Stress the brand's own words: it is not trying to be beef. That line becomes our whole positioning.

slides.title: The Company & Its Position
bullets: Founded by engineer Michael Pan; launched 2018; Mark Cuban invested $300K for 18% on Shark Tank in 2020 [S3][S4].
Revenue $3.15M (FY22) -> $2.88M (FY23) -> $2.78M (11 months FY24); net loss every year [S1].
Store count rose from about 750 to 2,500+ while revenue fell - fewer bags sold per store [S1][S2][S4].
Category tailwind: meat snacks +11.3% to $6.4B; headwind: plant-based meat -10% [S6][S7].

visual.desc: Line chart: revenue FY22-FY24 falling vs. bar chart of store count rising; category map with meat snacks up and plant-based meat down

slides.notes: This is our most important slide for credibility: every number comes from the company's own SEC filing.

slides.title: Target Market
bullets: P1 Gen-Z Snack Explorers, 14-24: Central Texas students who try snacks from TikTok and friends; love having a say in products [S8][S11].
P2 Flexitarian H-E-B Parents, 30-50: weekly H-E-B shoppers who use app coupons and want allergen-free snacks [S5][S9].
P1 creates the buzz; P2 buys the bags at the shelf during demo weekends.
Market: 6 in 10 US households already buy plant-based foods [S11].

visual.desc: Two persona cards with photo, demographics, psychographics, media habits

slides.title: Research Method & Results
bullets: Secondary (complete): SEC filing, GFI/SPINS, Circana via trade press, company pages - 11 sources [S1][S6][S7][S8].
Key results: revenue down while stores up [S1][S2]; meat snacks +11.3% [S7]; plant-based meat -10% [S6]; Chomps +61.5% shows new snack brands can break out [S8].
Primary (in field): 10-question survey of Central Texas snack buyers, 3-5 interviews with taste test, H-E-B shelf audit at 3 stores.
Influences: creator culture (social), plant-based fatigue (cultural), food inflation (economic), short video (technological) [S6][S7].

visual.desc: Methods table + category growth bar chart

slides.title: Insights -> Campaign Decisions
bullets: Finding: store count up, revenue down [S1][S2] -> therefore every entry path requires tasting at H-E-B or online with a coupon.
Finding: plant-based meat -10%, meat snacks +11.3% [S6][S7] -> therefore pitches are about flavor and snacking, never 'fake meat.'
Finding: founder won on Shark Tank [S3][S4] -> therefore the contest borrows the Shark Tank format the brand truly owns.
Finding: losses every year [S1] -> therefore prizes are low-cost and the winner's flavor goes to R&D after the campaign.

slides.notes: Survey results will add R1-R3 here.

slides.title: Campaign Strategy
bullets: Big idea: Pitch Your Flavor - Pan's won its own Shark Tank pitch; now Texas students pitch Pan's.
Positioning: Pan's is the savory snack built on a family recipe and a real pitch, not a meat imitation [S5].
IMC mix: Shared (#PitchYourFlavor UGC) + Paid (geo social) + Earned (Campus Tank PR) + Owned (email/SMS, demos).
Ownable: only Pan's has a Shark Tank founder story and Mark Cuban backing to anchor this format [S4].

visual.desc: Key visual: Shark Tank-style stage with a Pan's bag on a podium, 'Pitch Your Flavor' lockup

slides.notes: Judges are business people - a pitch competition speaks their language.

W3-4 (Mar 15-28): fan pitches and duets peak; weekend demos; retargeting to coupon viewers (P1/P2, O1).
W5-6 (Mar 29-Apr 11): top 5 announced; Campus Tank Finals in week 6 (P1, live event, O1/O3, events lead).
W7 (Apr 12-14): winner announced; results recap email; coupon expires (O1/O2).

slides.title: Proposed Budget & Financial Viability
bullets: Total $15,000: paid social $5,500 [A4]; creators $3,000 [A6]; demos 16 x $150 = $2,400 [A7]; finals $1,500 [A12]; coupon $1,500 [A8]; production $800 [A9]; tools $300 [A10].
Funnel: 4M impressions x 1.2% CTR x 11% purchase = 5,280 purchases x $8 brand revenue = $42.2K [A1][A4].
Gross profit at 42% = $17.7K; profit ROI 18%; ROAS 4.97x on $8.5K ad spend [A2].
Break-even 4,464 purchases. Conservative case (50%) 2,640 loses $6.1K in-window - offset by 6,000 owned subscribers and a new-flavor pipeline [O2].

visual.desc: Itemized budget + funnel math + base vs. conservative case

slides.notes: Lower in-window ROI than a pure trial program; the payoff is the owned audience and a product idea.

slides.title: Impact & Measurement
bullets: O1: attributed purchases via coupon platform, Shopify, and creator codes; target 5,000; weekly [O1].
O2: pitches and subscribers via landing page and email/SMS platform; target 1,500 and +6,000; weekly [O2].
O3: 4M impressions and 400 UGC videos via Ads Manager and hashtag tracking; +10 pts awareness pre/post [O3].
Trigger: if pitches are under 300 by week 2, add a $500 weekly prize boost; if demo QR scans are under 20 per shift, move demos to top stores [A4].

slides.title: Why It Matters
bullets: Thesis: Pan's won Mark Cuban on Shark Tank - now Texas students pitch Pan's, and every pitch starts with a taste at H-E-B [S4][O1].
Projected: 5,280 purchases, $42.2K brand revenue, 1,500 pitches, and a fan-created flavor idea [A1][O1][O2].
Mission: a family recipe that started with one pitch now invites thousands of young Texans to make their own [S2][S3].
Lasting asset: 6,000 owned subscribers and a repeatable contest format for every new market [O2].
